    • Terminally Deprecated Elements
      Element
      Description
      com.macstab.chaos.jvm.api.ChaosMetricsSink
      a second metrics API beside the events: the same count is chaos.applications of chaos-agent-micrometer's ChaosMeterBinder and of chaos-agent-opentelemetry, which a ChaosEventListener on APPLIED events can also produce for any other backend. This interface and chaos.effect.applied will be removed.
      com.macstab.chaos.jvm.quarkus.ChaosScenario
      Use WithChaos: it takes the full plan JSON model (every selector, effect and policy field), works with every test extension, and is honoured by ChaosQuarkusExtension too. This annotation only knows a few selectors and effect shorthands and will be removed in 3.0.
      com.macstab.chaos.jvm.quarkus.ChaosScenarios
      The container of the deprecated ChaosScenario; use WithChaos.
      com.macstab.chaos.jvm.startup.AgentArgs.getLong(String, long)
      no agent argument is a plain long any more (configWatchInterval and the other numbers are read by AgentSettings with their own validation); read the value with get(key) and parse it. To be removed in the next major release.
